title: Bernoulli marginal contribution
statement: For a parameter $p\in\mathbb R$, a function $f$ from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$, and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the Bernoulli marginal contribution to be the Bernoulli subset expectation at parameter $p$ of the function sending $S$ to $f(S\cup\{i\})-f(S\setminus\{i\})$.
